question:
Select the number from the given options that can replace the (?) in the following number series.

40, 48, 41, 16, 42, 8, 43, ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/064dde6192b14ad9a89205335f9aed9bba8ad5aa3af32fc52c478ef04b7e6e1a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d799a7a198185f62d5c3953082386ce2f56066f7a4107b21626f22f287a0a80f.png] 

So the value of '**?**' is** 8**.

Hence, **'option 1'** is the correct answer.
